name: How long does a typical bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade project varies based on its complexity and whether it's part of a larger renovation. A minor upgrade, like replacing a vanity light and a few outlets, might take a day or two. A more extensive project involving new wiring, circuit additions, recessed lighting installation, and electrical panel work could take several days to a week, especially if it requires wall demolition and repair. Frasheski Construction provides a projected timeline after assessing the full scope of work, including any necessary permitting and inspection schedules typical for projects in the East Bay.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: minor upgrades take 1-2 days, while extensive work with new wiring and panel upgrades can take several days to a week. A detailed timeline is provided after assessment.
